methodological_rigor.justification: The study combines TCGA-BRCA (n=741 post-processing) as training and GSE7390 (n=198) as external validation, uses limma for DEGs with BH FDR control (|logFC|>=0.585, adj p<0.05), LASSO followed by stepwise Cox to obtain an 8-gene risk model, reports AUCs at 1/3/5 years in both cohorts (0.735/0.784/0.752 TCGA vs 0.787/0.796/0.771 GSE7390), and builds a clinical nomogram with C-index 0.748. CIBERSORT, ssGSEA, xCell, ESTIMATE, TIDE, IPS, and TLS analyses complement the risk score. In vitro validation overexpresses ELOVL2 in BT474/SKBR-3 to show PI3K-AKT suppression. Weaknesses include: RT-qPCR cohort is very small (6 HER2-negative, 6 HER2-positive), no TRIPOD-style prespecified modeling pipeline, limited handling of the conflicting statement that no prognostic differences were found between HER2-negative/positive groups in Fig 1A-D yet the risk-score is labelled HER2-related, and limited adjustment for multiple hypothesis testing across the many immune/drug analyses.

clinical_relevance_loe.justification: Retrospective bioinformatic modeling across TCGA and GEO with small wet-lab validation maps to Oxford LoE 4. Clinical relevance is moderate because HER2-related risk stratification and ELOVL2-mediated PI3K-AKT suppression are plausible therapeutic directions, but external validation uses only one GEO cohort, sample sizes for in vitro and RT-qPCR validation are small, and no prospective or patient-level outcome data are generated.

reporting_quality.justification: TRIPOD fits because this is a multivariable prognostic model. The manuscript reports package versions (survival 3.2-13, limma 3.34.7, clusterProfiler 4.0.5, rms 6.2-0), thresholds, LASSO 10-fold CV description, training/validation ROCs, C-index, calibration description, ethics approval (WF2023-428), and reagent catalog numbers. TRIPOD items such as explicit sample-size justification, reporting of all predictors considered, and prespecified evaluation strategy are incomplete. Several source URLs are [REDACTED]. Data availability leverages public TCGA/GEO data but no code or custom data are deposited.

novelty_literature.justification: HER2-related prognostic gene signatures and TCGA-based nomograms for breast cancer are widely published (refs 66, 67, 68 cited), and the 8-gene signature largely recombines genes (CD24, CXCL9, KRT7, ELOVL2) already described in other cancer contexts. The in vitro demonstration that ELOVL2 overexpression inhibits PI3K-AKT in BT474/SKBR-3 echoes the cited ref 32 mechanism in prostate cancer. The contribution is incremental rather than novel; guarded against leniency, novelty is limited.

writing_presentation.justification: The manuscript follows an IMRaD structure and results are systematically reported, with clear figure references mapping to model performance, immune analyses, single-cell exploration, and in vitro validation. There are recurrent grammatical awkwardness ('prognosis of patients with breast cancer was analyzed revealed', 'Unpaired All statistical tests'), long unbroken sentences, and some overclaims (abstract states the nomogram has 'high accuracy' while calibration worsens at 5 years). Multiple [REDACTED] URL placeholders remain in Methods.

key_strengths: Combines TCGA-BRCA (n=741) and GSE7390 (n=198) for training and external validation with consistent AUCs at 1/3/5 years
Integrates DEG, enrichment, TME, immunotherapy response (TIDE/IPS/TLS), drug-sensitivity (GDSC via pRRophetic), single-cell (TISCH), RT-qPCR, and in vitro functional validation of ELOVL2
Reports tool and package versions (limma 3.34.7, survival 3.2-13, rms 6.2-0, maftools 2.8.0) with explicit thresholds and methods
Nomogram with C-index 0.748 offers a clinically interpretable combination of risk score, age, and M stage
key_concerns: Very small RT-qPCR validation cohort (6 HER2-negative, 6 HER2-positive) and limited in vitro validation (2 HER2+ vs 1 HER2- cell line)
Incoherent framing: Fig 1A-D finds no prognostic difference between HER2-negative and positive groups, yet downstream analyses are positioned as HER2-related prognostic modeling
Novelty is incremental since HER2 risk signatures and nomograms for breast cancer are already published (refs 66, 67, 68)
Multiple hypothesis testing across many immune/drug comparisons without a unified FDR strategy
No code deposition, many [REDACTED] URL placeholders, and calibration notably deteriorates at 5 years
chief_reviewer.rationale: A broad but derivative TCGA/GEO bioinformatics study with modest wet-lab validation. Tier 4 is appropriate and major revisions are needed to reconcile the HER2-prognosis framing, strengthen validation cohort size, and clarify multiplicity and data-sharing.
